fields.name: accessGroupId
fields.short: ID of the access group.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.short: Timestamp in milliseconds when the access group was created.

fields.name: membersCount
fields.short: Number of members in the access group.

fields.name: membersToAdd
fields.short: List of members to add to the access group.

fields.name: membersToRemove
fields.short: List of members to remove from the access group.

fields.name: name
fields.short: The name of this access group.

fields.name: projectsCount
fields.short: Number of projects in the access group.

fields.name: role
fields.short: The project role that will be added to this Access Group.

fields.name: teamId
fields.short: ID of the team that this access group belongs to.

fields.name: teamPermissions
fields.short: Permissions that the team has in the access group.

fields.name: teamRoles
fields.short: Roles that the team has in the access group.

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.short: Timestamp in milliseconds when the access group was last updated.

fields.name: activeAt
fields.short: Timestamp (in milliseconds) of when the token was most recently used.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.short: Timestamp (in milliseconds) of when the token was created.

fields.name: expiresAt
fields.short: Timestamp (in milliseconds) of when the token expires.

fields.name: id
fields.short: The unique identifier of the token.

fields.name: leakedAt
fields.short: Timestamp (in milliseconds) of when the token was marked as leaked.

fields.name: leakedUrl
fields.short: URL where the token was discovered as leaked.

fields.name: name
fields.short: The human-readable name of the token.

fields.name: origin
fields.short: The origin of how the token was created.

fields.name: prefix
fields.short: The token's prefix, for identification purposes.

fields.name: projectId
fields.short: The ID of the project to scope this token to

fields.name: revokedAt
fields.short: Timestamp (in milliseconds) of when the token was revoked.

fields.name: scopes
fields.short: The access scopes granted to the token.

fields.name: suffix
fields.short: The last few characters of the token, for identification purposes.

fields.name: type
fields.short: The type of the token.

fields.short: Connector branding icon.

fields.name: id
fields.short: Stable `scl_` connector ID.

fields.name: knownStale
fields.short: Whether the connector is known to have been edited since the app package it publishes to the provider was last built, so that package no longer matches it.

fields.name: managed
fields.short: Managed connector metadata exposed without leaking the manager connector or installation identifiers.

fields.name: name
fields.short: Connector name within the owning team.

fields.name: params
fields.short: Values for the selected connection method's template fields.

fields.name: projectId
fields.short: Project to connect during creation.

fields.name: reconsentNeeded
fields.short: Present when affected users must authorize the connector's new permissions.

fields.name: redirectUri
fields.short: Redirect URI registered with the third-party service for this connector, if any.

fields.name: reinstallAt
fields.short: Time when this connector started requiring reinstallation because an installation-affecting app-token grant changed.

fields.name: reinstallNeeded
fields.short: When true, prompt a team owner or administrator to reinstall the connector before relying on the change.

fields.name: service
fields.short: Best-effort identifier of the third-party service this connector represents, independent of `type`.

fields.name: serviceSync
fields.short: Result of synchronizing the change with the external service.

fields.name: supportedSubjectTypes
fields.short: Token subject types supported by the connector.

fields.name: supportsIcon
fields.short: Whether the connector icon can propagate to the provider.

fields.name: supportsInstallation
fields.short: Whether the connector supports an installation flow.

fields.name: supportsRevocation
fields.short: Whether Connect can revoke tokens for this connector.

fields.name: supportsTriggers
fields.short: Whether this connector type supports trigger webhooks.

fields.name: target
fields.short: Which of the service's products/surfaces this connector points at.

fields.name: triggerDestination
fields.short: Initial trigger destination.

fields.name: triggerDestinations
fields.short: Destinations that incoming triggers should be forwarded to.

fields.name: triggers
fields.short: Incoming trigger configuration for the connector.

fields.name: type
fields.short: Connector implementation type.

fields.name: typeIcon
fields.short: Icon identifier supplied by the connector type.

fields.name: typeName
fields.short: Human-readable name of the connector type.

fields.name: uid
fields.short: Team-scoped UID.

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.short: Last update time in epoch milliseconds.

fields.name: updatedBy
fields.short: Principal that most recently updated the connector.

fields.name: userTokens
fields.short: User-token capabilities and known grants for the connector.

fields.name: website
fields.short: Public website for the connected service.

fields.short: The files to include in the deployment.

fields.name: gitAccessToken
fields.short: Available only to Vercel platform accounts.

fields.name: gitMetadata
fields.short: Populates initial git metadata for different git providers.

fields.name: gitSource
fields.short: Defines the Git Repository source to be deployed.

fields.name: inspectorUrl
fields.short: Vercel URL to inspect the deployment.

fields.name: isRollbackCandidate
fields.short: Deployment can be used for instant rollback

fields.name: meta
fields.short: An object containing the deployment's metadata.

fields.name: monorepoManager
fields.short: The monorepo manager that is being used for this deployment.

fields.name: name
fields.short: A string with the project name used in the deployment URL

fields.name: oomReport
fields.short: Indicates if the deployment encountered an out-of-memory error.

fields.name: passiveConnectConfigurationId
fields.short: The ID of Secure Compute network used for this deployment's passive functions

fields.name: platform
fields.short: Metadata about the source platform that triggered the deployment.

fields.name: project
fields.short: The target project identifier in which the deployment will be created.

fields.name: projectId
fields.short: The project ID of the deployment

fields.name: projectSettings
fields.short: Project settings that will be applied to the deployment.

fields.name: proposedExpiration
fields.short: The expiration proposed to replace the existing expiration

fields.name: ready
fields.short: Timestamp of when the deployment got ready.

fields.name: readySubstate
fields.short: Substate of deployment when readyState is 'READY' Tracks whether or not deployment has seen production traffic: - STAGED: never seen production traffic - ROLLING: in the process of gradually transitioning production traffic - PROMOTED: has…

fields.name: seatBlock
fields.short: NSNB Blocked metadata

fields.name: softDeletedByRetention
fields.short: Optional flag to indicate if the deployment was soft deleted by retention policy.

fields.name: source
fields.short: The source of the deployment.

fields.name: state
fields.short: In which state is the deployment.

fields.name: target
fields.short: Either not defined, `staging`, `production`, or a custom environment identifier.

fields.name: type
fields.short: The type of the deployment.

fields.name: uid
fields.short: The unique identifier of the deployment.

fields.name: undeleted
fields.short: Timestamp of when the deployment was undeleted.

fields.name: url
fields.short: The URL of the deployment.

fields.name: withLatestCommit
fields.short: When `true` and `deploymentId` is passed in, the sha from the previous deployment's `gitSource` is removed forcing the latest commit to be used.

fields.name: boughtAt
fields.short: If it was purchased through Vercel, the timestamp in milliseconds when it was purchased.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.short: Timestamp in milliseconds when the domain was created in the registry.

fields.name: creator
fields.short: An object containing information of the domain creator, including the user's id, username, and email.

fields.name: customNameservers
fields.short: A list of custom nameservers for the domain to point to.

fields.name: echMode
fields.short: Whether the domain is enrolled in Encrypted Client Hello.

fields.name: expiresAt
fields.short: Timestamp in milliseconds at which the domain is set to expire.

fields.name: id
fields.short: The unique identifier of the domain.

fields.name: intendedNameservers
fields.short: A list of the intended nameservers for the domain to point to Vercel DNS.

fields.name: method
fields.short: The domain operation to perform.

fields.name: name
fields.short: The domain name.

fields.name: nameservers
fields.short: A list of the current nameservers of the domain.

fields.name: renew
fields.short: Indicates whether the domain is set to automatically renew.

fields.name: serviceType
fields.short: The type of service the domain is handled by.

fields.name: transferStartedAt
fields.short: If transferred into Vercel, timestamp in milliseconds when the domain transfer was initiated.

fields.name: transferredAt
fields.short: Timestamp in milliseconds at which the domain was successfully transferred into Vercel.

fields.name: verified
fields.short: If the domain has the ownership verified.

fields.name: applyToAllCustomEnvironments
fields.short: whether or not this env varible applies to custom environments

fields.name: comment
fields.short: A user provided comment that describes what this Shared Env Var is for.

fields.name: created
fields.short: The date when the Shared Env Var was created.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.short: Timestamp for when the Shared Env Var was created.

fields.name: createdBy
fields.short: The unique identifier of the user who created the Shared Env Var.

fields.name: customEnvironmentIds
fields.short: The custom environment IDs that this Shared Env Var is scoped to.

fields.name: decrypted
fields.short: whether or not this env variable is decrypted

fields.name: deletedAt
fields.short: Timestamp for when the Shared Env Var was (soft) deleted.

fields.name: deletedBy
fields.short: The unique identifier of the user who deleted the Shared Env Var.

fields.name: id
fields.short: The unique identifier of the Shared Env Var.

fields.name: key
fields.short: The name of the Shared Env Var.

fields.name: lastEditedByDisplayName
fields.short: The last editor full name or username.

fields.name: ownerId
fields.short: The unique identifier of the owner (team) the Shared Env Var was created for.

fields.name: projectId
fields.short: The unique identifiers of the projects which the Shared Env Var is linked to.

fields.name: target
fields.short: environments this env variable targets

fields.name: type
fields.short: The type of this cosmos doc instance, if blank, assume secret.

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.short: Timestamp for when the Shared Env Var was last updated.

fields.name: updatedBy
fields.short: The unique identifier of the user who last updated the Shared Env Var.

fields.name: updates
fields.short: An object where each key is an environment variable ID (not the key name) and the value is the update to apply

fields.name: value
fields.short: The value of the Shared Env Var.

fields.name: activation
fields.short: Whether the new key is activated automatically after its public key has propagated, or manually via the activate endpoint.

fields.name: algorithm
fields.short: Algorithm of the signing key.

fields.name: claims
fields.short: The claims to include in the token.

fields.name: claimsSchema
fields.short: A JSON Schema used to validate the resolved token claims when signing tokens for this issuer.

fields.name: environments
fields.short: The environments for the project grant policy.

fields.name: headers
fields.short: Additional headers to include in the token.

fields.name: importKey
fields.short: The PEM-encoded private key to use for the issuer.

fields.name: importKeyId
fields.short: The key id to use as the imported key's JWT/JWKS `kid`.

fields.name: keyId
fields.short: Key id of the signing key.

fields.name: message
fields.short: Base64-encoded message to be signed.

fields.name: name
fields.short: The name of the issuer.

fields.name: projectId
fields.short: The project ID for the project grant policy.

fields.name: revokePreviousAfterHours
fields.short: How many hours after activation the previously-active key should stop being used.

fields.name: revokePreviousAt
fields.short: Deprecated.

fields.name: signature
fields.short: Standard-base64 encoding of the raw signature over the decoded message bytes.

fields.name: tokenClaims
fields.short: The claims that KMS should include in signed JWTs for this policy.

fields.name: ttl
fields.short: The time-to-live for the token, in seconds.

fields.name: x5c
fields.short: The X.509 certificate chain (RFC 7517 §4.7).

fields.name: x5tS256
fields.short: The base64url SHA-256 thumbprint of the DER certificate in `x5c[0]` (RFC 7517 §4.9).

fields.short: Billing data (interim invoicing data).

fields.short: The ID of the billing plan the resource is subscribed to, if applicable

fields.name: created
fields.short: System creation date.

fields.name: discounts
fields.short: Invoice discounts.

fields.name: eod
fields.short: End of Day, the UTC datetime for when the end of the billing/usage day is in UTC time.

fields.short: Partner-supplied Invoice ID, if applicable.

fields.name: final
fields.short: Set this to `true` if this is the final invoice for the installation.

fields.name: id
fields.short: The ID provided by the 3rd party provider for the given resource

fields.name: internalId
fields.short: The ID assigned by Vercel for the given resource

fields.name: invoiceDate
fields.short: Invoice date.

fields.name: invoiceId
fields.short: Vercel Marketplace Invoice ID.

fields.name: invoiceNumber
fields.short: User-readable invoice number.

fields.name: items
fields.short: Invoice items.

fields.name: memo
fields.short: Additional memo for the invoice.

fields.name: metadata
fields.short: The configured metadata for the resource as defined by its product's Metadata Schema

fields.name: name
fields.short: The name of the resource as it is recorded in Vercel

fields.name: notification
fields.short: The notification, if set, displayed to the user when viewing the resource in Vercel

fields.name: paidAt
fields.short: Moment the invoice was paid.

fields.name: partial
fields.short: If true, will only update the provided secrets

fields.name: partnerId
fields.short: The ID provided by the partner for the given resource

fields.name: period
fields.short: Subscription period for this billing cycle.

fields.name: productId
fields.short: The ID of the product the resource is derived from

fields.short: Any settings provided for the resource to support its product's protocols

fields.name: buildCommand
fields.short: The build command for this project.

fields.name: comment
fields.short: A comment to add context on what this env var is for

fields.name: connectConfigurations
fields.short: The list of connections from project environment to Secure Compute network

fields.name: customEnvironmentIds
fields.short: The custom environments that the environment variable should be synced to

fields.name: customerSupportCodeVisibility
fields.short: Specifies whether customer support can see git source for a deployment

fields.name: deploymentExpiration
fields.short: Retention policies for deployments.

fields.name: deploymentPolicy
fields.short: Project shape.

fields.name: devCommand
fields.short: The dev command for this project.

fields.name: dismissedToasts
fields.short: An array of objects representing a Dismissed Toast in regards to a Project.

fields.name: enableAffectedProjectsDeployments
fields.short: Opt-in to skip deployments when there are no changes to the root directory and its dependencies

fields.name: enableExternalRewriteCaching
fields.short: Specifies whether external rewrite caching is enabled for this project.

fields.name: enablePreviewFeedback
fields.short: Opt-in to preview toolbar on the project level

fields.name: enableProductionFeedback
fields.short: Opt-in to production toolbar on the project level

fields.name: environmentVariables
fields.short: Collection of ENV Variables the Project will use

fields.name: framework
fields.short: The framework that is being used for this project.

fields.name: gitBranch
fields.short: Git branch to link the project domain

fields.name: gitForkProtection
fields.short: Specifies whether PRs from Git forks should require a team member's authorization before it can be deployed

fields.name: gitLFS
fields.short: Specifies whether Git LFS is enabled for this project.

fields.name: gitRepository
fields.short: The Git Repository that will be connected to the project.

fields.name: hostname
fields.short: The deployment hostname to scope the trace session to.

fields.name: installCommand
fields.short: The install command for this project.

fields.name: internalContentHint
fields.short: Similar to `contentHints`, but should not be exposed to the user.

fields.name: key
fields.short: The name of the environment variable

fields.name: legacyValue
fields.short: Legacy now-encryption ciphertext, present after migration swaps value/vsmValue

fields.name: name
fields.short: The desired name for the project

fields.name: newProjectName
fields.short: The desired name for the project

fields.name: oidcTokenConfig
fields.short: OpenID Connect JSON Web Token generation configuration.

fields.name: optionsAllowlist
fields.short: Specify a list of paths that should not be protected by Deployment Protection to enable Cors preflight requests

fields.name: outputDirectory
fields.short: The output directory of the project.

fields.name: passport
fields.short: Passport configuration for the project.

fields.name: passwordProtection
fields.short: Allows to protect project deployments with a password

fields.name: previewDeploymentSuffix
fields.short: Custom domain suffix for preview deployments.

fields.name: previewDeploymentsDisabled
fields.short: Specifies whether preview deployments are disabled for this project.

fields.name: projectId
fields.short: The unique target project identifier

fields.name: protectedSourcemaps
fields.short: Specifies whether sourcemaps are protected and require authentication to access.

fields.name: publicSource
fields.short: Deprecated.

fields.name: redirect
fields.short: Target destination domain for redirect

fields.name: redirectStatusCode
fields.short: Status code for domain redirect

fields.name: resourceConfig
fields.short: Specifies resource override configuration for the project

fields.name: rollbackDescription
fields.short: Description of why a project was rolled back, and by whom.

fields.name: rollingRelease
fields.short: Project-level rolling release configuration that defines how deployments should be gradually rolled out

fields.name: rootDirectory
fields.short: The name of a directory or relative path to the source code of your project.

fields.name: sandbox
fields.short: Specifies the default region and failover regions for sandboxes created in the project

fields.name: serverlessFunctionRegion
fields.short: The region to deploy Serverless Functions in this project

fields.name: serverlessFunctionZeroConfigFailover
fields.short: Specifies whether Zero Config Failover is enabled for this project.

fields.name: skewProtectionAllowedDomains
fields.short: Cross-site domains allowed to fetch skew-protected assets (hostnames, optionally with leading wildcard like *.example.com).

fields.name: skewProtectionBoundaryAt
fields.short: Deployments created before this absolute datetime have Skew Protection disabled.

fields.name: skewProtectionMaxAge
fields.short: Deployments created before this rolling window have Skew Protection disabled.

fields.name: skipGitConnectDuringLink
fields.short: Opts-out of the message prompting a CLI user to connect a Git repository in `vercel link`.

fields.name: sourceFilesOutsideRootDirectory
fields.short: Indicates if there are source files outside of the root directory

fields.name: ssoProtection
fields.short: The Vercel Auth setting for the project (historically named \"SSO Protection\")

fields.name: staticIps
fields.short: Manage Static IPs for this project

fields.name: sunsetSecretId
fields.short: This is used to identify variables that have been migrated from type secret to sensitive.

fields.name: target
fields.short: The target environment of the environment variable

fields.name: tracing
fields.short: Tracing configuration for this project

fields.name: trustedIps
fields.short: Restricts access to deployments based on the incoming request IP address

fields.name: trustedSources
fields.short: Deployment Protection Trusted Sources

fields.name: type
fields.short: The type of environment variable

fields.name: value
fields.short: The value of the environment variable

fields.name: verification
fields.short: A list of verification challenges, one of which must be completed to verify the domain for use on the project.

fields.name: verified
fields.short: `true` if the domain is verified for use with the project.

fields.name: visibility
fields.short: User-facing config/secret model.

fields.name: alias
fields.short: The staging alias for previewing this version.

fields.name: createdBy
fields.short: The user who created this version.

fields.name: id
fields.short: Unique identifier for the version.

fields.name: isLive
fields.short: Whether this version is currently live in production.

fields.name: isStaging
fields.short: Whether this version is staged and not yet promoted to production.

fields.name: lastModified
fields.short: Timestamp of when this version was last modified.

fields.name: position
fields.short: Controls where the route is inserted.

fields.name: restore
fields.short: If true, restores the staged route to the value in the production version.

fields.name: route
fields.short: The full route object to replace the existing route with

fields.name: ruleCount
fields.short: The number of routing rules in this version.

fields.name: s3Key
fields.short: The S3 key where the routing rules are stored.

fields.name: version
fields.short: A version of routing rules stored in S3.

fields.name: args
fields.short: The arguments of the command.

fields.name: command
fields.short: The executable or shell command to run.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.short: The time when the snapshot was created, in milliseconds since the epoch.

fields.name: creationMethod
fields.short: The method used to create the snapshot.

fields.name: currentSandboxName
fields.short: Current sandbox name the drive is attached to, if any.

fields.name: currentSessionId
fields.short: Current session ID the drive is attached to, if any.

fields.name: currentSnapshotId
fields.short: The snapshot ID to set as the current snapshot.

fields.name: cwd
fields.short: The current working directory of the command.

fields.name: durationMs
fields.short: Duration of the command execution in milliseconds.

fields.name: env
fields.short: Additional environment variables to set for this command.

fields.name: exitCode
fields.short: If the command did finish, the exit code.

fields.name: expiration
fields.short: The number of milliseconds after which the snapshot will expire and be deleted.

fields.name: expiresAt
fields.short: The time when the snapshot will expire, in milliseconds since the epoch.

fields.name: failoverRegions
fields.short: The regions the sandbox falls back to when it cannot be created in `region`.

fields.name: id
fields.short: The ID of the command.

fields.name: image
fields.short: Image to use for the sandbox.

fields.name: keepLastSnapshots
fields.short: Protect the N most recent snapshots with different expiration/deletion behavior.

fields.name: lastUsedAt
fields.short: The last time the snapshot was used (e.g.

fields.name: logs
fields.short: If true, stream the logs of the command execution in real-time via ND-JSON.

fields.name: maxSizeBytes
fields.short: The maximum drive size in bytes.

fields.name: memory
fields.short: Memory allocated in MB.

fields.name: mounts
fields.short: List of drives to mount to the sandbox at the provided path.

fields.name: name
fields.short: The name of the command.

fields.name: networkId
fields.short: The Connect network id for the target Secure Compute private network.

fields.name: networkPolicy
fields.short: Network policy configuration.

fields.name: parentId
fields.short: The unique identifier of the parent snapshot, if this snapshot was created from another snapshot.

fields.name: path
fields.short: The path of the directory to create.

fields.name: persistent
fields.short: Whether the sandbox persists its state across restarts via automatic snapshots.

fields.name: ports
fields.short: List of ports to expose from the sandbox.

fields.name: projectId
fields.short: The project that owns the drive.

fields.name: recursive
fields.short: If true, creates parent directories as needed (like `mkdir -p`).

fields.name: region
fields.short: The region where the snapshot is stored.

fields.name: regions
fields.short: The regions where the snapshot is available.

fields.name: resources
fields.short: Resources to define the VM

fields.name: runtime
fields.short: The runtime environment for the sandbox.

fields.name: sandbox
fields.short: This object contains information related to a Vercel NamedSandbox.

fields.name: session
fields.short: This object contains information related to a Vercel Sandbox Session.

fields.name: sessionId
fields.short: The ID of the session associated with the command.

fields.name: sizeBytes
fields.short: The size of the snapshot in bytes.

fields.name: snapshotExpiration
fields.short: Default snapshot expiration time in milliseconds.

fields.name: source
fields.short: The source from which to initialize the sandbox filesystem.

fields.name: sourceSessionId
fields.short: The unique identifier of the session from which the snapshot was created.

fields.name: startedAt
fields.short: When the command was started, in milliseconds since the epoch.

fields.name: status
fields.short: The status of the snapshot.

fields.name: statusUpdatedAt
fields.short: The time when the sandbox status was last updated, in milliseconds since the epoch.

fields.name: sudo
fields.short: Execute the command with root (superuser) privileges.

fields.name: tags
fields.short: Key-value tags to associate with the sandbox.

fields.name: timeout
fields.short: Maximum duration in milliseconds the command may run before it is killed with SIGKILL, up to 5 hours.

fields.name: totalActiveCpuDurationMs
fields.short: Cumulative active CPU duration in milliseconds across all sandbox runs.

fields.name: totalDurationMs
fields.short: Cumulative wall-clock duration in milliseconds across all sandbox runs.

fields.name: totalEgressBytes
fields.short: Cumulative egress bytes across all sandbox runs.

fields.name: totalIngressBytes
fields.short: Cumulative ingress bytes across all sandbox runs.

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.short: The last time the snapshot was updated, in milliseconds since the epoch.

fields.name: vcpus
fields.short: Number of virtual CPUs allocated.

fields.name: wait
fields.short: If true, returns an ND-JSON stream that emits the command status when started and again when finished.

fields.name: accessRequestedAt
fields.short: Timestamp in milliseconds when the user requested access to the team.

fields.name: apiKeysInvalidatedAt
fields.short: Timestamp (ms) after which API keys created at or before this time are considered invalid for this team.

fields.name: appTokensInvalidatedAt
fields.short: Timestamp (ms) after which Vercel App tokens created at or before this time are considered invalid for this team.

fields.name: attribution
fields.short: Attribution information for the session or current page

fields.name: avatar
fields.short: The ID of the file used as avatar for this Team.

fields.name: billing
fields.short: The team's billing plan.

fields.name: bitbucket
fields.short: Map of the connected Bitbucket account.

fields.name: confirmed
fields.short: Current status of the membership.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.short: UNIX timestamp (in milliseconds) when the Team was created.

fields.name: creatorId
fields.short: The ID of the user who created the Team.

fields.name: defaultDeploymentProtection
fields.short: Default deployment protection for this team null indicates protection is disabled

fields.name: defaultExpirationSettings
fields.short: Default deployment expiration settings for this team

fields.name: defaultPassport
fields.short: Default Passport configuration for new projects in this team.

fields.name: defaultProjectJobs
fields.short: Default job configuration applied to new projects created in this team.

fields.name: defaultRoles
fields.short: Default roles for the team.

fields.name: deploymentPolicy
fields.short: Composable deployment-time policy for the team.

fields.name: description
fields.short: A short description of the Team.

fields.name: disableRepositoryDispatchEvents
fields.short: Default for projects in the team.

fields.name: disjunctiveProductionSecretPolicy
fields.short: Require production secrets to use a different value than preview or development.

fields.name: dpAccessRequestsMode
fields.short: Controls who can request access to protected deployments.

fields.name: emailDomain
fields.short: Hostname that'll be matched with emails on sign-up to automatically join the Team.

fields.name: enablePolyrepoBranchRouting
fields.short: Whether Preview Deployments can link to branches with the same name in other Git repositories.

fields.name: enablePreviewFeedback
fields.short: Whether toolbar is enabled on preview deployments

fields.name: enableProductionFeedback
fields.short: Whether toolbar is enabled on production deployments

fields.name: fallbackEnvironment
fields.short: The new fallback environment for the microfrontends group.

fields.name: github
fields.short: Map of the connected GitHub account.

fields.name: gitlab
fields.short: Map of the connected GitLab account.

fields.name: hideIpAddresses
fields.short: Indicates if IP addresses should be accessible in observability (o11y) tooling

fields.name: hideIpAddressesInLogDrains
fields.short: Indicates if IP addresses should be accessible in log drains

fields.name: id
fields.short: The Team's unique identifier.

fields.name: integrationTokensInvalidatedAt
fields.short: Timestamp (ms) after which integration tokens created at or before this time are considered invalid for this team.

fields.name: inviteCode
fields.short: Code that can be used to join this Team.

fields.name: joinedFrom
fields.short: A map that describes the origin from where the user joined.

fields.name: membership
fields.short: The membership of the authenticated User in relation to the Team.

fields.name: name
fields.short: Name associated with the Team account, or `null` if none has been provided.

fields.name: nsnbConfig
fields.short: NSNB configuration for the team.

fields.name: orgRootTeamId
fields.short: Best-effort ID of the organization’s root billing team.

fields.name: pagination
fields.short: This object contains information related to the pagination of the current request, including the necessary parameters to get the next or previous page of data.

fields.name: parentId
fields.short: The organizationId for teams that belong to an organization (set on both the organization's root team and its child teams).

fields.name: personalAccessTokensInvalidatedAt
fields.short: Timestamp (ms) after which personal access tokens created at or before this time are considered invalid for this team.

fields.name: platform
fields.short: Whether the team is a platform team.

fields.name: previewDeploymentSuffix
fields.short: The hostname that is current set as preview deployment suffix.

fields.name: regenerateInviteCode
fields.short: Create a new invite code and replace the current one.

fields.name: remoteCaching
fields.short: Is remote caching enabled for this team

fields.name: requireVerifiedCommits
fields.short: When enabled, all projects in the team require commits to be signed and verified by the git provider before deployments will be created.

fields.name: resourceConfig
fields.short: Resource configuration for the team.

fields.name: role
fields.short: The role in the team of the member.

fields.name: saml
fields.short: When "Single Sign-On (SAML)" is configured, this object contains information regarding the configuration of the Identity Provider (IdP).

fields.name: sensitiveEnvironmentVariablePolicy
fields.short: Sensitive environment variable policy for this team

fields.name: slug
fields.short: The Team's slug, which is unique across the Vercel platform.

fields.name: stagingPrefix
fields.short: The prefix that is prepended to automatic aliases.

fields.name: strictConnectors
fields.short: When enabled, creating and managing connectors requires Owner role or the ConnectorManager permission.

fields.name: strictDeploymentProtectionSettings
fields.short: When enabled, deployment protection settings require stricter permissions (owner-only).

fields.name: strictPasswordProtectionSettings
fields.short: When enabled, adding, changing, or removing project password protection requires Owner role.

fields.name: strictShareableLinks
fields.short: When enabled, creating shareable links requires Owner role.

fields.name: teamName
fields.short: The name of the team.

fields.name: teamPermissions
fields.short: The team permissions to set for the member.

fields.name: teamSlug
fields.short: The slug of the team.

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.short: Timestamp (in milliseconds) of when the Team was last updated.

fields.name: categories
fields.short: The categories that group this event with related event types.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.short: Timestamp (in milliseconds) of when the event was generated.

fields.name: entities
fields.short: A list of "entities" within the event `text`.

fields.name: id
fields.short: The unique identifier of the Event.

fields.name: principalId
fields.short: The ID of the principal who generated the event.

fields.name: sessionId
fields.short: The ID of the session that the principal's token belongs to, when it belongs to one.

fields.name: text
fields.short: The human-readable text of the Event.

fields.name: tokenId
fields.short: The public ID of the token that the principal authenticated with, when the request behind this event carried one.

fields.name: type
fields.short: The type of the event.

fields.name: user
fields.short: Metadata for {@link userId}.

fields.name: userId
fields.short: When the principal who generated the event is a user, this is their ID; otherwise, it is empty.

fields.name: via
fields.short: Metadata for {@link viaIds}.

fields.name: viaIds
fields.short: If the principal delegated its authority (for example, a user delegating to an app), then this array contains the ID of the current actor.

fields.name: arch
fields.short: CPU architecture the manifest targets.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.short: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the image was created.

fields.name: id
fields.short: Internal identifier of the image.

fields.name: imageId
fields.short: Internal identifier of the image the tag points at.

fields.name: kind
fields.short: Whether the manifest is a multi-platform image index, a single-platform image manifest or an attestation.

fields.name: manifestDigest
fields.short: SHA-256 digest of the image manifest.

fields.name: name
fields.short: Name of the repository.

fields.name: platform
fields.short: Operating system the manifest targets.

fields.name: projectId
fields.short: Identifier of the project the repository belongs to.

fields.name: public
fields.short: Whether the repository is public.

fields.name: pushedBy
fields.short: Identifier of the actor that pushed the image.

fields.name: repositoryId
fields.short: Identifier of the repository the image belongs to.

fields.name: sizeInBytes
fields.short: Total size in bytes of the image's resources (manifest, config and layer blobs) stored by the registry.

fields.name: status
fields.short: VHS-readiness status, or `null` for a multi-platform index.

fields.name: tag
fields.short: The tag name.

fields.name: tags
fields.short: Tags pointing at this image's manifest.

fields.name: teamId
fields.short: Identifier of the team that is granted access to the repository.

fields.name: teamSlug
fields.short: Slug of the team that is granted access to the repository.

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.short: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the tag was last updated.
